persona.label: Tukey-inspired data and statistics reviewer
persona.role: Audit whether summaries, comparisons, uncertainty, and study design justify the numerical claim.
principles: Distinguish exploratory patterns from confirmatory conclusions.
Inspect denominators, pairing, missingness, variability, and multiplicity.
Prefer robust summaries and visible uncertainty to a single headline number.
required_questions: Does the statistic match the design and unit of analysis?
Are uncertainty and variability represented adequately?
Could missingness, selection, multiplicity, or aggregation reverse the conclusion?
self_limits: Do not judge broad theoretical novelty unless it changes statistical validity.

items.claim_text: In the original frozen 18-cell study, the protected automated evaluator labeled 11 of 36 claims in condition A and 3 of 36 claims in condition B as unsupported; the mean paired condition-B-minus-condition-A effect was -0.2222 and the 10,000-resample hierarchical-bootstrap 95% interval was [-0.4167, -0.0833].

linked_evidence.interpretation_boundary: Automated protected-evaluator result; human audit pending.

items.claim_text: The retrospective component study derived four output paths from the same nine pre-delivery registries without rerunning the upstream controller, conclusion generator, or gate; all 36 branch registries and nine linked evidence trees were hash-bound before evaluator inference.

path_derivations: identity branch of frozen input registry
linked_evidence.execution_boundary: The controller, conclusion generator, and gate were not rerun.

items.claim_text: A hash-pinned cross-family NLI proxy labeled 5 of 27 evaluable claims in path P0 as non-entailed and 0 evaluable claims in each of paths P1, P2, and P3; for each active path versus P0, the mean paired difference was -0.1852 and the exact two-sided sign-flip p-value was 0.125.

Path P1 retained 22 of 36 claims, whereas paths P2 and P3 each retained 36 of 36; P2 and P3 had identical claim content in all nine pairs, so the recheck stage produced no observed marginal delivery change in this sample.

linked_evidence.scope_boundary: No observed marginal change in this artifact sample; not a general claim that rechecking is useless.

items.claim_text: Within this retrospective sample, the proxy improvement is localized to the first verification and delivery decision, while the recheck has no observed marginal effect; this does not establish a prospective causal system effect or preserved scientific informativeness.

observations: P1, P2, and P3 each have zero NLI non-entailment among evaluable claims
P2 and P3 are identical on all measured outcomes
the NLI evaluator was not calibrated to human judgments
explicit_limits: lexical proxies are not semantic-preservation ground truth
